data.text: I’m on board with a shared limit, Emma. Could we make it 17 tons each this month? Leaving 15 rather than 10 gives us 30 tons instead of 20 if replenishment fails, for just $1,000 less each now. After that, let’s adjust to the actual stock, always leave at least 5 tons, and rotate any extra whole tons fairly. We can review everyone’s revealed catches each month to keep the agreement accountable. John, would you agree to 17?
